content:
Hurricane Helene struck the Manatee Creek farm on 2024-09-26 and killed multiple flock animals. When a DB record has a suspect bulk-cleanup status_date (see bulk-cleanup-status-dates memory) and the operator says "X died in helene," the real status_date is 2024-09-26.

Direct quote (operator, 2026-04-26): "sam died in helene."

Confirmed Helene casualties as of 2026-04-26:
- `sam` (100% Gulf Coast Native ram, former Pen 3 ram)
- `half-tail` (per docs/sheep_visual_id_process.md)

Earlier hurricane: Hurricane Idalia (~2023) also produced flock deaths — per Nori's record her son Eclipse died in Idalia. NOTE: HLS task `memory-eclipse-idalia-scrub` disputes this — says Eclipse was actually sold at auction 2026-04-26, not a hurricane casualty. Cross-check when using.

When investigating a stale-deceased record, "did this animal die in Helene or Idalia?" is a high-yield disambiguation question.
